# speckit decision

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

The decision tier posture (feature 087, ADR-0109): report whether the `[decision]` tier is enabled, its transport and model, whether the `apiKeyEnv` variable is present, and the resolved provider for the `decision` role

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit decision <COMMAND>
```
